args.sql:
SELECT CASE
  WHEN LOWER(text) LIKE '%smell%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%scent%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%fragrance%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%odor%' THEN 'scent'
  WHEN LOWER(text) LIKE '%clean%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%fresh%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%squeaky clean%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%rinse%' THEN 'clean/fresh'
  WHEN LOWER(text) LIKE '%lather%' THEN 'lather'
  WHEN LOWER(text) LIKE '%soft%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%moistur%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%dry%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%itch%' THEN 'skin feel'
  WHEN LOWER(text) LIKE '%exfoliat%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%grit%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%scrub%' THEN 'exfoliation'
  WHEN LOWER(text) LIKE '%value%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%price%' OR LOWER(text) LIKE '%worth%' THEN 'value'
  ELSE 'other'
END AS praise,
COUNT(*) AS n
FROM reviews
WHERE parent_asin = 'B0BYBCFHTB' AND rating = 5
GROUP BY praise
ORDER BY n DESC;
